description: Reads the Game tab as the server serves it (GET /api/tirage): today's tickets and closing time (today's ticket = 1 entry in this week's reward pot; the pot is shared by entries after the week closes, UTC), this week's entries and its TicketPot pot as read by the server (null if not read), the live preview face (the face the latest Base block would draw), the BlockRolls contract when one is served (prices, prizes, pot) or null (practice: free rolls, nothing to sign), and the recent off-chain practice rolls (GET /api/jeu/rolls). With `wallet`: that wallet's ticket (held or not, verified volume, skin pass), its ticket face as the 5-trait guess tblock_plan_roll uses by default, and its entries in this week's pot (the month count is a tally only). Read-only.

wallet.description: Optional: the wallet whose ticket and progress to read.

name: tblock_game_state
title: Read the Game: your ticket, the week's pot, the rolls
